scripts.build:android: VITE_BEO_APP_TARGET=client vite build --mode android && node scripts/check-android-dist.mjs --variant=client && node scripts/check-bundle-boots.mjs
scripts.build:android:prod: VITE_BEO_APP_TARGET=client vite build --mode android-prod && node scripts/check-android-dist.mjs --variant=client && node scripts/check-bundle-boots.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android && BOE_CAPACITOR_VARIANT=client cap sync android && node scripts/check-phonepe-native-target.mjs --variant=client
scripts.android:sync:prod: npm run build:android:prod && BOE_CAPACITOR_VARIANT=client cap sync android && node scripts/check-phonepe-native-target.mjs --variant=client
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && BOE_CAPACITOR_VARIANT=client cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && BOE_CAPACITOR_VARIANT=client cap run android
